reference: Published north elevation, architectural design drawing. Pixel origin at the upper-left of its unscaled 1080 × 710 image.
planar_scale_assumption: The two separate vertical spans agree within 0.3%. Horizontal values assume the original published drawing preserved its aspect ratio. Read edges to roughly two pixels; perspective, construction and repairs have additional uncertainty.
source_depths: The architectural elevation cannot give projection depths. The V-shaped window faces and masonry turn, the two columns in front of the green gate, and the soffit recur in the published street-level photographs. Projection depth, timber/steel profiles and joint widths are estimates.
